idea: 融合概念1的拥挤度与价值因子交互，以及概念2的ESG不均衡检测逻辑。通过行业内zscore计算价值与拥挤度的背离（平方放大极端背离），再乘以ESG总分作为质量过滤，捕捉行业内部被错误定价且基本面稳健的价值标的。
expression_list: signed_power(subtract(group_zscore(rsk74_value_ts, industry), group_zscore(rsk74_crowding, industry)), 2) * group_zscore(add(add(rsk74_factor_e, rsk74_factor_s), rsk74_factor_g), industry)
signed_power(subtract(group_zscore(rsk74_value_ts, industry), group_zscore(rsk74_crowding, industry)), 2) * group_zscore(add(add(rsk74_factor_esg, rsk74_factor_s), rsk74_factor_g), industry)
signed_power(subtract(group_zscore(rsk74_value_ts, industry), group_zscore(rsk74_raw_crowding, industry)), 2) * group_zscore(add(add(rsk74_factor_e, rsk74_factor_s), rsk74_factor_g), industry)
